_meta.purpose: Curated, pre-approved employment / career quotes. The generator picks one unused quote per day and authors a bespoke design around it. Mark used ones with a date in `used` to avoid repeats (30-day rule).
rules: Attribution required. Keep 'author' short; 'role' optional context.
Prefer quotes that empower jobseekers / early-career talent.
Avoid politics, salary-guarantee claims, and anything off-brand.
